items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I got Big Sid Catlett on drums.

ctx.x: That -- is that drummer Sid Catlett?
That sure looks like him. You bet.

items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: In fact, our rhythm section consisted of Israel Crosby on bass, Big Sid Catlett (inaudible) on drums... But anyway, that was the rhythm section in Fletcher's band.

ctx.x: How many weeks did that thing -- gig last?

This was at the Capital Theater, which was an MGM house. I think that gig lasted four or either six weeks. And of course, we had Xavier Cugat and his band there, Robert Ralph Walker and Lena Horn, what an the attractions. So while we were there, we had a session for the recording session, you know, for Lena Horn, and I made most of the arrangements that were recorded, and I remember distinctly I had a couple of arrangements there that he didn't conduct them, and I needed another piano player. So Big Syd said,…

She came in and did a good job, and I could confine my activities to the conductor of the band (inaudible) recorded, so that was great, and old Syd was out of sight. So -- let's see -- if I remember correctly, Syd made a few dates on the road, but not many. He was another like Benny Martin. He didn't dig the road too much.
